title: Mother Holding Baby Outdoors, 1940s B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A mid-1940s black and white snapshot capturing a smiling woman holding a baby outdoors. She sits in a wooden lawn chair near a trellis with climbing vines against the side of a house featuring a brick foundation and light siding. She wears a typical 1940s dress with puffed sleeves. The photograph has decorative deckled borders.
